Inline style operations for the WYSIWYG markdown editor (RichStyleOperations): toggle Bold, Italic, Code or Strike over a selection (removed when every character has it, otherwise applied to all; across blocks skipping Raw and code blocks; within a table, the selected text of every cell from the start cell to the end cell in reading order, the same cell walk as table delete), the style state over a selection for the toolbar (all, none or mixed per flag, plus the link when the range is one link), a pending style for typing after a toggle at a caret, and setting or removing links (a caret in or at either edge of a link acts on the whole link, keeping its title unless a new one is given, and the toolbar state shows that link; a caret elsewhere, an empty document included, inserts the url as linked text, trimmed, on one line and never inline code). Images and other atoms in the range take bold, italic, strike and links like text, so a bolded or linked selection containing an image writes as one span; they never take inline code. The typing style at a caret is RichEditOperations' own rule, shared by paragraphs and table cells. Runs split at the range edges and merge afterwards, and a block is marked dirty only when a style actually changed. Round-trip tests write and re-read bold mid-word, bold and links over an image, a link over styled text, and bold and links across table cells.

Table layout for the WYSIWYG markdown editor (RichTableLayout): each cell reuses the paragraph line builder at its column's width, header cells are bold, column alignment comes from the delimiter row, rows are as tall as their tallest cell, and columns keep their natural width until the table is too wide - then the long columns give up room while short ones stay on one line. Clicks anywhere in the grid (padding, grid lines, outside it) land in the nearest cell, and RichCaret now carries the cell's row and column. Table and text block layouts share IRichBlockLayout, so the editor keeps one list of block layouts; tables take the viewer's 12 px spacing and grid/stripe colours from RichLayoutStyle.

Undo and redo for the WYSIWYG markdown editor (RichEditHistory, built on UndoBuffer): each step snapshots the document and selection, typing undoes a word at a time, Backspace and Delete runs merge, and paste, Enter, formatting and every other edit are their own step. A pending-style change or caret move ends a typing run, an edit that changed nothing adds no step, a line-start shortcut undoes on its own back to the typed "# ", Undo and Redo hand back fresh clones so an untouched block writes its original bytes again, and history keeps the last 200 steps.
